title: Lid stopped opening completely after 1 year, expensive replacement bags.
text:
Lid stopped opening completely after 1 year, expensive replacement bags.. Updated. About a year after having this garbage can, the lid stopped raising all the way. It only opens about 2 inches when using the foot peddle to open it.

I love the size. It's attractive and I love that you don't have to actually touch the can to throw trash away. All you do is step on the paddle at the bottom and it opens. It doesn't slam close, it gently closes.

Cons: It appears to be all stainless color on the photo but it's only stainless color on top. The rest of it is white.
I'm still looking for regular bags that don't cost $1 each to fit the can. This is the reason for 3 stars. Our trash fills quickly, if yours does too, then this probably isn't the can for you.

features: POD IN, ODORS OUT - Our all-natural odorsorb pod fits discreetly under the lid of your simplehuman can to eliminate trash odors.
NATURALLY EFFECTIVE - Our active ingredients are all-natural, using a precise formula of plant oils, fine-tuned to neutralize odors that occur in trash – no harsh chemicals and no cover scents.
EACH POD PROVIDES ODOR-FREE TRASH FOR 45 DAYS - The odorsorb pod's microporous membrane continuously releases just the right dosage — that means it's just as effective on day 45 as it was on day one.

REFRESH WITH A REFILL - When the odorsorb pod’s chamber is empty, simply remove it from the holder and slide in a new refill — so quick and easy, you won’t have to deal with smelly trash for even a minute.
WHAT’S IN THE BOX – 1 Odorsorb pod holder and 2 odorsorb pods
description: The simplehuman odorsorb pod starter pack comes with an odorsorb pod holder and two odorsorb pods, which neutralize trash odors for 45 days using plant-based natural oils and no harmful chemicals. The odorsorb pod holder easily attaches under your trash can lid with an adhesive strip, and the odorsorb pods are easy to remove and replace.
